top.line: A pivot brief for agenticcells.ai: the sovereign website, own, control, change, run anywhere, keep.

in-short.line: Sovereignty first; deliverables shown; five designs; a £50 or €50 launch offer; a European launch.

today.line: Examples, an honest offer, partner pages, ten languages, five designs, a trust page.

missing.line: A photo first, "cell" jargon, no sovereignty, no lock-in in small print, competitors unnamed.

message.line: A website you own, control and can take anywhere, with the six promises led by sovereignty.

deliverables.line: Repository, live site, five designs, CLAUDE.md, policy and checks, ownership in three months.

infographics.line: Tenets, rent or own, can you leave, brief to your own Claude, the team.

designs.line: Sovereign, six promises, stop renting, just say it, proof.

launch.line: £250 at a promotional launch price of £50, €50 in Europe; less than a few months of a platform, once.
launch.para: Five of six simulated buyers said yes at £50.

europe.line: Add Italian, Dutch and Polish first, euros on every European site, sovereignty in each language.

stays.line: Partners, price, free evaluations, examples, trust page, languages, open source.

ask.line: Build the next version around this brief, every claim linked; then to market with partners.
ask.para: The team's runs resume when restarted.

limits.line: A brief, not built; a soft requirement; competitors from their own pages.

sources.line: agenticcells.ai v0.1.269 and the newsroom's recent articles.
